name: Board Buddies-VR Multiplayer Board Games
summary:
Gather your friends and family around the table—virtually! Board Buddies – VR Multiplayer Board Games brings your favorite board games to life in an exciting new way. Whether you’re rolling dice, moving pawns, or plotting your next big strategy, every move feels more immersive than ever before.
